item.title: Bakunyuu Gyaru Chikan Densha
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nagiya Honpo
  • 発売日: 2022-01-29
  • スコア: 5.2299999999999995/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 爆乳ギャル痴漢電車
  • 英語名: Bakunyuu Gyaru Chikan Densha

あらすじ

A man with nothing to lose has no fear.

The protagonist is working a dead-end, stressful job, and has no prospects or interests in life.

Except one thing, his one and only joy in life…molesting girls on the train.

However, one morning, a busty gal catches him, and the gig is up.

别名

あらすじ

Everybody thinks my little sister Yuuki is just so cute.

And sure, they’re not wrong – she’s got a big tits and a pretty face, after all.

But her personality… she’s just such a bitch! Even today, we had a pretty bad fight.

Well anyway, just watch.

item.title: Onna Maou no Fukushuki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nagiya Honpo
  • 発売日: 2016-08-11
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 女魔王の復讐記
  • 英語名: Onna Maou no Fukushuki

别名

  • Onna Maou no Fukushuu-ki

あらすじ

Final battle

Everything in this world knew the battle.

That is to say, the hero who was the only person

recklessly challenged the Demon King.

And the hero boldly fought the Demon King,

succeeded in sealing the Demon King through numerous battles.

That is the content of the final battle that has been passed down to the present.
